summary: UPLOAD-GUARD-1 (v1) e2e verified across backend, web, and mobile (both surfaces). Backend 11/11 pytest pass (existing suite backend/tests/test_upload_guard.py). WEB: all 7 flows pass — Invoice Checker with care-plan .txt renders 'Wrong document?' notice + upload-guard-open-right-tool 'Open the Care Plan Reviewer' that redirects to /ai-tools/care-plan-reviewer; unrelated .txt renders block notice ('We couldn't use this file') with NO open-right-tool and upload-guard-choose-another present; valid invoice .txt bypasses guard and renders inv1-result; confirm-tier weak invoice renders 'Just checking' + upload-guard-continue and clicking Continue anyway re-submits with override and reaches inv1-result; Care Plan Reviewer with invoice .txt renders wrong-tool 'Open the Invoice Checker' + redirects to /ai-tools/invoice-checker; genuine care-plan .txt reaches cp-file-result; paste-text of a genuine care plan completes and renders findings (visible in screenshot). MOBILE: both tool screens (/tool/invoice-checker, /tool/care-plan-reviewer) load without runtime errors after guard wiring — all expected testIDs render (inv1-upload-card, inv1-pick-file on invoice; care-plan-form, cp-pick-files, cp-text, cp-submit on CPR). The Expo web preview does not expose a driveable HTML file input (0 <input type=file> nodes; expo-document-picker uses the native picker), so end-to-end drive of the mobile guard verdict is out of scope for the web preview — the shared backend classify_upload() is the same code path both surfaces call, and it's covered by backend tests + web e2e.

issues: Non-blocking React hydration console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — pre-existing, unrelated to UPLOAD-GUARD-1

critical_code_review_comments: UploadGuardNotice (mobile) uses router.replace on wrong-tool tap — good, avoids leaving a wrong tool behind in nav stack.
InvoiceCheckerTool.jsx onUpload(override=true) appends form field 'override_guard=true' — matches server contract in routes/invoices.py.
Web guard 'Choose a different file' button (upload-guard-choose-another) resets both file and guard state via onReset — correct.

Care Plan Reviewer passes onChooseAnother that clears files+guard but does NOT wire onContinue for confirm tier (guard is only rendered for blocks); acceptable because CP flow currently only surfaces block/wrong-tool from backend per registry weights, but if a confirm verdict ever leaks through the UI would only show 'Choose a different file' — worth a defensive onContinue if CP thresholds change.
seed_data_creation: Created disposable fixtures in /tmp: ug_careplan.txt (care-plan signals), ug_unrelated.txt (unrelated block), ug_invoice.txt (valid invoice), ug_weak.txt (confirm-tier), ug_careplan_rich.txt (accept care plan). No DB seed changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Guard verdict UI ships identically on web (UploadGuardNotice.jsx) and mobile (UploadGuardNotice.tsx). Mobile file-drive is not achievable on Expo web preview (native picker). To exercise mobile guard verdicts end-to-end, use a real Expo Go/native build or drive the backend directly (already covered by backend/tests/test_upload_guard.py 11/11). Statement→StatementDecoder redirect on Invoice Checker is a separate pre-existing path (inv1-statement-redirect) and is NOT part of UPLOAD-GUARD-1 — do not conflate.
